name: Frost Shard
notes: HoH1 has a 6th level: 16 hybrid damage, 6 ricochets. HoH2 projectiles can already bounce, with a damage multiplier per bounce.
summary: Fire a frost shard that ricochets off walls and enemies, dealing 10% more damage with every bounce. It was HoH1's basic attack: no mana, a 0.35 s cooldown.
